description: This is a Java interface defining service methods for reading scorecard data within the Fineract project, including methods to retrieve scorecards by client, survey, or both.

classes.name: ScorecardReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to retrieve scorecard data for clients and surveys.

methods.name: retrieveScorecardByClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecards associated with a specific client.

methods.name: retrieveScorecardBySurveyAndClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecards associated with a specific survey and client.

methods.name: retrieveScorecardBySurvey
methods.description: Retrieves scorecards associated with a specific survey.
